primary_evidence.finding: Management states currently planned 2027 and 2028 supply will not fully meet customer demand, is investigating 2028 capacity beyond the previously communicated 30% increase, and reports strong productivity-upgrade demand in Installed Base Management.

2027 Low-NA EUV was described as close to fully covered with orders; ASML planned roughly 30% Low-NA EUV and immersion capacity increases for 2027 and was investigating a further roughly 30% expansion for 2028.

primary_evidence.source: ASML Q1 2026 results / forward-looking risk disclosure, 2026-04-15
primary_evidence.finding: ASML explicitly identifies order conversion, cancellations/delays/push-outs, export restrictions, supply-chain capacity and ability to adjust production capacity as material uncertainties.

survives: The supply-demand imbalance premise is directly stated by ASML and is not merely inferred.
Installed-base productivity upgrades are a separately identified revenue channel and Q3 2026 management attributed above-guidance IBM sales to continued strong productivity-upgrade demand.
Q2 order coverage gives stronger support than customer-interest language alone for the 2027 Low-NA EUV portion.
fails_or_unproved: Scarcity does not by itself prove incremental pricing power or normalized margin durability.
The frozen claim does not establish how much of 2028 indicated demand is firm/non-cancellable versus forecast or interest.
Capacity expansion can increase output while adding supplier/ramp costs, so the margin transmission remains conditional.
The causal driver is materially exposed to AI-related customer capex expectations and therefore is not independent of generic AI-demand continuation.
Export controls and order push-outs can break backlog-to-revenue conversion even when headline demand exceeds planned supply.

non_blocks: No documentary contradiction to the existence of a 2027-2028 planned-supply shortfall was found.
No price/outcome evidence was used, so no leakage or outcome-tuning finding is introduced by this validation.
red_team.reason: Primary evidence supports capacity scarcity and installed-base upgrade demand, but not the stronger causal step that scarcity itself supports durable pricing/mix and normalized earnings. Commitment quality beyond 2027 Low-NA EUV remains insufficiently decomposed, while ramp cost, export-control and AI-capex confounders are material.

allowed_claim: ASML reports planned 2027-2028 leading-edge supply below indicated customer demand and strong installed-base productivity-upgrade demand; this supports a bounded capacity-scarcity and installed-base monetization mechanism for further test design.
forbidden_claim: Current documentary evidence does not establish durable pricing power, normalized margin expansion, backlog conversion certainty, or earnings outperformance from the scarcity mechanism.

integration_handoff.reason: A BLOCK_CLAIM_LEVEL remains and the task does not separately authorize an integration handoff despite that blocker.
